item.title: Mumbai Open 125k: Last Season’s Runner-up Mananchaya Sawangkaew Sets Up Final Clash With Lilli Tagger
item.description: Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association: The penultimate day of the Mumbai Open WTA 125K Series served tense clashes at the Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association (MSLTA).

item.title: T20 WC: Noor Ahmad Misses As Afghanistan Ask New Zealand To Field
item.description: T20 World Cup: Afghanistan won the toss and elected to bat first against New Zealand in the fourth match of the T20 World Cup here at the MA Chidambaram Stadium.

item.title: India U17 Blank Bangladesh U19 To Win SAFF U19 Women's Title
item.description: Sree Moti Trishna Rani: They may have been playing in a higher age-category tournament; they may have been written off for it. But the India U17 women’s team showed their mettle in the final to clinch the SAFF U19 Women’s Championship, defeating Bangladesh U19s 4-0 at the Pokhara Rangasala Stadium, on Saturday.

item.title: Statistical Review: India Beat USA By 29 Runs In T20 World Cup
item.description: India began their ICC Men’s T20 World Cup campaign with a 29-run victory over the USA at the Wankhede Stadium on Saturday, but not without moments of genuine concern.

item.title: Barcelona, Real Sociedad Both Win As Rain Gives Problems In La Liga
item.description: European Super League Company: FC Barcelona enjoyed a comfortable 3-0 win at home to Mallorca on Saturday to move four points clear of Real Madrid at the top of La Liga ahead of Real Madrid's visit to Valencia on Sunday.

item.title: T20 WC: Nothing To Lose, Everything To Gain – Italy Prepares For Its Moment In Spotlight
item.description: When Herbert Kilpin: When Herbert Kilpin founded the Milan Football and Cricket Club in 1899, the Englishman could scarcely have imagined that 127 years later, an Italian cricket team would play in a cricket World Cup. Under the Monday morning sunshine at the Eden Gardens in Kolkata, Italy will make its Men’s T20 World Cup debut against Scotland, a game that will be broadcasted to millions across the globe.

item.title: Arsenal Nine Points Clear In Premier League After Beating Sunderland
item.description: Premier League: Arsenal overcame stubborn first-half resistance from Sunderland to strengthen its grip at the top of the Premier League with a 3-0 home win on Saturday, moving nine points clear of both Manchester City and Aston Villa.

item.title: T20 WC: Gavaskar Lauds Varma’s Composed Knock In India’s Opener Vs USA, Calls Him ‘street-smart Cricketer’
item.description: T20 World Cup: India’s narrow escape against the USA in their ICC Men’s T20 World Cup opener has drawn praise and pointed analysis from former captain Sunil Gavaskar, who highlighted Tilak Varma’s composure while also outlining what he expects from India in their next match against Namibia.

item.title: Mumbai Open 125K: High-stakes Final Awaits As Lilli Tagger And Mananchaya Sawangkaew Battle For Singles Title
item.description: Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association: After a week of non-stop tennis action, the stage is set for a thrilling finale at the Mumbai Open WTA 125K Series as Thailand’s Mananchaya Sawangkaew and Austria’s teenage prodigy Lilli Tagger lock horns in the women’s singles final at the Centre Court of Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association (MSLTA) on Sunday.

item.title: From Football Giants to Cricket Dreamers: Italy’s Historic T20 World Cup Moment
item.description: Four-time football world champions Italy make a historic debut at the T20 Cricket World Cup, embracing their “miracolo Italiano” as they face Scotland, England, West Indies and Nepal.
